questions.correct_answer: B. Calcium entry- Acetylcholine release- Na+ entry
questions.explanation:
Solution:

Calcium entry- Acetylcholine release- Na+ entry On arrival of action potential , there is opening of voltage gated calcium channels through which calcium influx occurs, leading to calcium mediated exocytosis of acetylcholine and finally Na+ influx results in local depolarization and formation of endplate potential

questions.text: The resting membrane potential (RMP) of the nerve is -70mV. Increased permeability of which ion is responsible for the RMP?
questions.raw_text: The resting membrane potential (RMP) of the nerve is -70mV. Increased permeability of which ion is responsible for the RMP?
questions.explanation:
Solution:

Potassium Resting membrane potential is generated by the K+ that leaks from the inside of the cell to the outside via leak K+ channels and generates a negative charge in the inside of the membrane vs the outside. At rest , the membrane is impermeable to Na+ , as all of the Na+ channels are closed.

Highyeild:

Resting membrane potential(RMP) of neurons is usually about -70mV . Because there are more open K + channels than Na + channels at rest, membrane permeability of K + is greater. Intracellular and extracellular K + concentrations are prime determinants of RMP. Depolarization stage: Membrane suddenly becomes permeable to sodium ions, allowing rapid diffusion of positively charged sodium ions to the interior of the axon. The normal polarized state of −70 millivolts is immediately neutralized by the inflowing, positively charged sodium ions, with the potential rising rapidly in the positive direction—a process called depolarization Repolarization stage: Sodium channels begin to close, and the potassium channels open to a greater degree than normal. Then, rapid diffusion of potassium ions to the exterior re-establishes the normal negative resting membrane potential, which is called repolarization of the membrane.

questions.correct_answer: C. It takes hours to days for kidney to synthesize enzymes that produce NH4+
questions.explanation:
Solution:

It takes hours to days for kidney to synthesize enzymes that produce NH4+ Metabolic acidosis is the condition of primary bicarbonate deficit that results from excessive removal of bicarbonate into urine in order to buffer the extra acids of the body. To restore acid-base balance, the kidneys initiate a complex set of responses that include increased ammonia genesis and gluconeogenesis, enhanced acid and ammonium ion excretion, and a net production and release of bicarbonate ions.
